header: THE SAVED FARES (table public.train_fare, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/21_train_fare.sql). The plant uses RailRadar's paid fare service for one month only (to 14 Dec 2026), so I save every fare received here with the time it was received, and the card shows that time ("Fares last received ..."). After the month the rows simply stay. There is one row per train, replaced whenever the train's fares are received again. Nothing here may break a card: database trouble is logged once and the store then answers "nothing saved" (get) or does nothing (put), exactly like src/lib/search/edsStore.ts, whose pattern I follow.

behaviours: nothing is saved at first, and the table is made on first use
fares written come back the same, with the time they were received
a train has one row: saving it again replaces the old fares and the time
the table is checked once, not at every request
a table that exists is not made again
the table statements close it to the public roles (row-level security on, rights revoked from anon and authenticated)
if the table cannot be made, get says 'nothing saved' and put does nothing, without an error
a row is read (classes as text or as data; distance as text or number)
a row with a broken time, a broken class, a wrong number or day, or no classes list is not shown
the Asansol store writes and reads its own table (train_fare_asn), makes it by itself, and its rows say they are from ASN; Durgapur's table is untouched
